caseNameFull: H. A. Moss and J. F. Bradford, in Error v. C. C. Moore
summary: In error to the Supreme Court of the State of California.
attorneys: Mr. A. E. Shaw, for plaintiffs in error, submitted., Mr. E. S. Pillsbury, Mr. William F. Herrin, Mr. Alexander Britton, Mr. Evans Browne, Mr. Julius Kahn, Mr. Burke Corbet and Mr. John R. Selby for defendants in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of Thomas v. Iowa, 209 U. S. 258; Appleby v. Buffalo, 221 U. S. 524, 529; Manhattan Life Ins. Co. v. Cohen, 234 U. S. 123, 134.
